execution_frontier.name: Protected full-corpus R2 from promoted R1 flow-restored hybrid
execution_frontier.summary: The completed R1 model failed its original machine gate because model_g.flow drifted. Restoring only the 112 flow tensors from the exact warm-start produced a persisted hybrid that passed the corrected 125-row gate on all five deterministic seed schedules (625/625 decisions) with 125 unique persisted primary renders. Protected R2 is now authorized from this exact hybrid with model_g.flow frozen and hash-verified unchanged. Human CNS perceptual acceptance remains blocked until R2 machine success.

root_cause.evidence: R1 as-is scored 104/107/100 across three seed schedules; decoder-only reset scored 107/108/101; flow-only reset scored 125/125/125. The persisted flow-restored hybrid subsequently scored 125/125 across all five promotion schedules.
root_cause.repair_rule: Preserve R1 DWC/text-side and decoder learning; restore and protect the known-good warm-start flow.

protected_r2_contract.flow_policy: model_g.flow parameters frozen, excluded from generator optimizer, and state-prefix hash checked unchanged at completion
protected_r2_contract.learning_rates: retain Piper v1.8.0 defaults for remaining trainable generator/discriminator parameters
protected_r2_contract.probe_guard: fixed-seed row-level floor >= -55 dBFS and no individual probe may fall more than 18 dB from its promoted-hybrid baseline; median guard retained too
protected_r2_contract.intermediate_gate_rule: corrected unique 125-row primary seed gate must remain 125/125 or R2 aborts and preserves a diagnostic checkpoint
protected_r2_contract.final_gate: 125/125 on each of five deterministic seed schedules, with 125 uniquely persisted primary-gate WAVs

next_safe_execution.on_abort: Do not retry blindly. Upload the generated DWC_R2_PROTECTED_RESULT_*.zip and diagnose the exact guard boundary.
next_safe_execution.on_success: Upload the generated DWC_R2_PROTECTED_RESULT_*.zip. Review hashes/gates, then prepare the separate human CNS perceptual acceptance package.

enter human perceptual acceptance before protected R2 machine success

treat machine waveform acceptance as human CNS perceptual acceptance
